citation.title: Real-time equilibrium reconstruction by multi-task learning neural network based on HL-3 tokamak
citation.authors: G.H. Zheng, Z.Y. Yang, S.F. Liu, R. Ma, X.W. Gong, A. Wang, S. Wang, W.L. Zhong

topic: Neural-network surrogate of offline EFIT magnetic equilibrium reconstruction on HL-3; multi-task outputs (8 shape/q parameters, 129x129 flux and current density).
own_question: Can a fast NN reproduce offline EFIT outputs from 68 magnetic channels at sub-millisecond inference?
actual_method_and_evidence: Supervised regression on 1159 HL-3 shots. Shot-ordered splits: 70% train, 20% validation used for model selection, 10% test. Labels are offline EFIT outputs, not independent truth. Reported inference times are 0.08–0.45 ms on an A100 with TensorRT, not measured in a control loop. Extrapolation was tested by shot number and by plasma current. No CES, BES/ECEI, ion temperature, or temporal nowcasting.
input_target_timing_if_relevant: Same-time-slice magnetic inputs map to same-slice EFIT outputs; no causal temporal structure and no report latency.
validation_if_relevant: Chronological shot split, with validation reused for selection. Current-interval extrapolation and a small augmentation experiment using later shots are reported; no real-time deployment.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite as evidence for CES/ion-temperature nowcasting or BES/ECEI utility.
Do not treat its sub-ms GPU timing as real-time deployment or as relevant to our 10 ms grid.
Do not present EFIT-label agreement as physical truth.
Do not generalize it to claim all prior ML equilibrium work is single-task or noncausal.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Different quantity, diagnostics and task. At most, it could serve as one example of NN surrogates for offline codes evaluated with shot-chronological splits. Optional; likely exclude.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
